q.en: How do I request a visit?

a.id: Gunakan nomor publik 6281213519191. Pastikan nomor masih dikelola praktik, lalu tunggu konfirmasi jadwal.
a.en: Use the public number 6281213519191. Confirm it is still managed by the practice, then wait for appointment confirmation.
